summary: Nexentis Technologies filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-5 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective 4:15 p.m. ET on November 6, 2026, following stockholder authorization at the April 30, 2026 special meeting and board approval of the exact ratio. A Certificate of Amendment was filed with Nevada on November 5, 2026; split-adjusted Nasdaq trading under symbol NXTS begins November 9, 2026. Options and warrants are proportionately adjusted and fractional shares rounded up. This is a routine capital-structure mechanic, not a special situation; watch post-split liquidity and any compliance-driven motive.
